text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to pick between shipping the new streaming API + customer-facing analytics in Apr or pausing until a SOC2 baseline is in place. Thoughts? @lena, enterprise pipeline asking for compliance before commit.

arjun: My read: streaming API is ~3 sprints, analytics another 2. Full SOC2 audit prep is 6–9 sprints. We could do a scoped SOC2 subset in 2–3 sprints (logging, RBAC, retention). RICE rough thinking: features vs compliance.

lena: Agree on scoped controls. Propose "SOC2-lite": encrypt at rest, RBAC, basic audit logs, retention policy, data mapping. Hits most vendor questionnaires and reduces legal friction. Full audit after V1.

tom: From sales: customers will accept "SOC2 in progress + interim controls" if we add contract language and an interim security playbook. Several deals ask for compliance clause next quarter.

emi: Caution — promising audit timelines in contracts is risky. Prefer: "compliance roadmap + interim controls + third-party pen test" as proof points.

sam-cs: CS input: top enterprise accounts ask for ISO27001 or equivalent and GDPR data-mapping. They're flexible on audit timing if we provide data flow diagrams and a SOC2 control matrix.

maya: Proposal: Plan A = ship streaming + analytics with SOC2-lite and public roadmap & customer playbook. Plan B = delay features 8 weeks to complete full SOC2 pre-audit. Which to prioritize? Suggest using RICE at initiative level and a sequencing matrix.

arjun: Quick RICE (very rough) to compare priorities:
- streaming API: R8 I6 C2 E2 => 8*6/(2*2)=12
- analytics: R7 I5 C3 E2 => 7*5/(3*2)=5.8
- SOC2-lite: R9 I8 C4 E3 => 9*8/(4*3)=6
- SOC2-full: R10 I9 C9 E8 => 10*9/(9*8)=1.25
This suggests streaming + SOC2-lite in parallel, analytics can be delayed.

lena: Sounds right. We should spin a small compliance squad (security + one infra eng + one PM) to own controls required for enterprise sales.

maya: Action items: I'll add these to the prioritization board with dev day estimates and acceptance criteria. @tom @sam-cs please flag the top two customers for early rollout and any legal must-haves.

deploy-bot: maya deployed branch feature/streaming-api to staging at 1768505000 :rocket:

tom: flagged -> AcmeCorp and Kestrel Systems. Both require a note on data residency and want the data map.

maya: Thanks. I'll update the PRD: acceptance criteria = "SOC2-lite implemented: encryption at rest, RBAC, basic audit logs, retention policy, data map available". Tentative ship target Apr 12. Keeping full audit on the roadmap post-launch.
